text.lead: Mobile Homes is a 2017 Canadian drama film directed by Vladimir de Fontenay. It was screened in the Directors' Fortnight section at the 2017 Cannes Film Festival.
text.cast:
- Imogen Poots as Ali
- Callum Turner as Evan
- Callum Keith Rennie as Robert
- Frank Oulton as Bone
text.production: Filming took place in southern Ontario near the Canada–United States border.
text.reception: On review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, the film holds an approval rating of 58% based on 19 reviews, and an average rating of 6.05/10.
